title: Hunter x Hunter Releases New Trailer For Upcoming Return
content: Later this month, the time will finally come to return to Weekly Shonen Jump’s most popular manga focusing on hunters and, arguably, one of the biggest series the publication has been known for.
author: ComicBook

title: 'Gokigenyō, Ikkyoku Ikaga?' Mahjong Manga Gets TV Anime
content: Houbunsha 's Comic Fuz website announced on Friday that Tsukasa Unohana 's Gokigenyō, Ikkyoku Ikaga? ( Good Day to You, How About a Game? ) 4-panel mahjong manga is getting a television anime. Unohana drew a commemorative illustration: Kaori ( Stardust Telepath ) is directing the anime at Felix Film .
author: ANN

title: Manga 'Gokigen You, Ikkyoku Ikaga?' Gets TV Anime Adaptation
content: Video game developer Yostar Co, LTD. announced a television anime adaptation of Tsukasa Unohana 's Gokigen You, Ikkyoku Ikaga? ( Good Day to You, How About a Game? ) manga on Friday, revealing the main staff and a celebratory illustration (pictured) by Unohana.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Masa Ichikawa to Launch New Joker Manga Based on DC Comics Character in Morning Magazine
content: This year's 30th issue of Kodansha 's Morning magazine revealed on Thursday a new manga based on DC Comics ' Joker , titled Machibura JOKER (Joker Walking Around Town), which will launch in the magazine's next issue on July 2. Masa Ichikawa is drawing the manga.
author: ANN

title: Akane Torikai's Bad Babies Don't Cry Manga Ends
content: This year's 30th issue of Kodansha 's Morning magazine published the final chapter of Akane Torikai 's Bad Babies Don't Cry ( Bad Baby wa Nakanai ) manga on Thursday. The manga entered its final arc on April 30.
author: ANN

title: Jujutsu Kaisen Season 4 Is About to Break Fans’ Hearts (And These Three Details Proves It)
content: Just a few months after the end of Jujutsu Kaisen Season 3, MAPPA has unveiled new details about Season 4, including a new teaser for the anime. Despite being barely a minute long, the teaser confirms that Season 4 will continue the Culling Game arc and includes several details that are easy to miss at first glance.
author: ComicBook

title: Bleach Creator Hypes Big Summer Announcement
content: This summer, the Soul Society is set to once again return to the small screen as Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War will unleash its fourth and final season. With Ichigo Kurosaki on a collision course with Yhwach, the leader of the Sternritter, who has absorbed the power of the Soul King, things seem dire for the…
author: ComicBook

title: The Super Mario Galaxy Movie Drops to #5, Kiki's Delivery Service Film's 4K Remaster Debuts at #6 in Japan
content: The Super Mario Galaxy Movie — Nintendo , Illumination , and Universal Pictures ' sequel to The Super Mario Bros. Movie — dropped from #4 to #5 in its ninth weekend. The film earned 94,036,320 yen (about US$581,500) from Friday to Sunday, and has earned a cumulative total of 7,644,406,980 yen (about US$47.27 million).
author: ANN

title: DC Unveils First-Ever Anime Joker: Laugh Riot, Absolute Batman and Krypto Animated Series
content: DC Studios and Warner Bros. Animation unveiled several new animated projects during their first-ever joint presentation at the Annecy International Animation Film Festival, including the studio’s first anime series, Joker: Laugh Riot , a new adaptation of Absolute Batman , and a Krypto animated series.
author: Anime Corner

title: 'Jirai nan desu ka? Chihara-san' Reveals Additional Cast, Staff, Winter 2027 Debut
content: The official website for the television anime adaptation of Ryon 's Jirai nan desu ka? Chihara-san ( Are You a Jirai Girl, Chihara-san? ) manga revealed additional cast and staff on Thursday.
author: MyAnimeList
